Dithiocarbamates are compounds containing the functional group R2NC(S)S-, where R represents organic groups. When these compounds react with acids, I need to consider what chemical reactions might occur and what products might form.

When dithiocarbamates react with acids, they can decompose to release carbon disulfide (CS2) and hydrogen sulfide (H2S). Both of these gases are toxic.
